chunks: And the parent and the offspring,

key_terms.وَمَا وَلَدَ: And what he/she has given birth to (offspring/descendants)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'the parent and the offspring'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the foundational unit of the family as the primary site of moral and spiritual transmission, linking the authority of the parents to the broader concept of lineage (nasab). It is frequently cited in discussions of *Fiqh al-Ahl al-Bayt* to establish the rights of offspring towards their progenitors, emphasizing that filial piety is a direct reflection of one's devotion to the Imams and the Prophet's household.
